title: Assignment 1
text:
In this video, Mustafa Baydoğan explains how data science and industrial engineering work together.
His most important point is this: Before solving a problem, you need to understand it well. Simply feeding data into a computer and waiting for results isn’t enough. First, you need to understand why the problem exists, then collect the right data.
He gives various examples in his talk. For instance, he discusses predicting why lumber warps, estimating electricity consumption, and how to rank products on websites. These examples demonstrate how data science is used in many real-world applications.
He also says that simple and understandable models are often more useful. Because in business, it’s not enough to just get the right result; you also need to explain why that result occurred.
His most important advice to students is this: This field is best learned by doing. Just watching lectures isn’t enough. You need to work on real problems, practice, and learn through mistakes.
In short, this seminar shows that data science is not just a technical field; it needs to be considered in conjunction with problem understanding, correct thinking, and decision-making processes.





According to the seminar, why is learning by practice important in data science?
Answer: Because data science involves real-world problems, messy data, and decision-making processes. For this reason, theoretical knowledge alone is not enough, and students need practical experience to understand how to apply methods correctly.



According to the seminar, what is one of the most important steps in data science?
A) Using the most complex algorithm
B) Understanding the real problem correctly
C) Collecting only large amounts of data
D) Choosing deep learning for every problem
